starter_prompts: Set up my brand from these approved examples.
Make one transparent brand asset that means human approval.
Make the complete launch pack for this offer and website.

positive.prompt: Study these approved brand examples and write a reusable visual recipe before we make anything new.
positive.expected_behavior: Classify the supplied references, ask only unresolved approval questions, and stop for approval after writing the brand recipe.

positive.prompt: Make one transparent icon-like asset that means a person approved the work.
positive.expected_behavior: Plan one semantic object, check approved sources first, and save one padded PNG plus its asset receipt.

positive.prompt: Make a wide website illustration of a team handoff and leave the right half quiet for our headline.
positive.expected_behavior: Plan a multi-part scene, protect the requested copy area, check the real pixels, and save the scene and receipt.

positive.prompt: Turn Capture, Clarify, Connect, and Complete into four separate matching brand assets.
positive.expected_behavior: Show and approve a four-item plan before generation, then check each asset and the full family.

positive.prompt: Animate this approved approval stamp with a small loop, without redrawing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the approved pixels, choose a restrained motion, check key frames and the loop seam, and save the motion record.

positive.prompt: Make the profile pictures, banners, carousel, story and launch images for every channel.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the four launch answers, approve one placement table, render the selected pack, and save copy, alt text, tracked links, receipts, proofs, and a public campaign manifest.

negative.prompt: Write a quarterly marketing plan for my company.
negative.reason: This is strategy writing, not visual asset generation.

negative.prompt: Resize this existing banner to 1200 by 628 without changing anything else.
negative.reason: A simple mechanical resize does not need the full brand workflow.

negative.prompt: Create a photorealistic product video ad with actors and voiceover.
negative.reason: A full video production is outside these static and subtle-motion skills.
